```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)

source("../data/heart-catheterization_06_debug.R")
rhc <- read_rhc("../data/arf.csv")
diagnoses <- read_csv("../data/diagnoses.csv")
```

## How do patients who received RHC compare to patients who did not?

### Race

```{r}
rhc |> plot_rhc(race)
```


### Age

```{r}
rhc |> plot_rhc(age)
```

### Blood Pressure

```{r}
rhc |> plot_rhc(bp)
```

## Patients with other diagnoses

### Chronic Renal Disease

```{r}
summarize_diagnosis(rhc, diagnoses, "renalhx")
```

### Congestive Heart Failure

```{r}
summarize_diagnosis(rhc, diagnoses, "chfhx")
```

## Survival curve

```{r}
kaplan_meier(rhc)
```
